measured.official_recipe_on_T4: Neither official configuration fits a 15 GB T4 at 8,192 tokens per GPU: SDPA runs out of memory in the first forward pass with 14 GiB already allocated, before gradients or optimizer state exist. So the activations of one 8,192-token forward pass through the 28-layer, 612M-parameter model are most of the card on their own
